scripts.build: npm run build -w @remote-oc/protocol && npm run build -w @remote-oc/client && npm run build -w @remote-oc/web && npm run build -w @remote-oc/bff
scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @remote-oc/bff" "npm run dev -w @remote-oc/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @remote-oc/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @remote-oc/client && npm run typecheck -w @remote-oc/web && npm run typecheck -w @remote-oc/bff
